topic: 近一年SLAM技术在具身智能领域是否发挥核心作用？在具身数据采集、操作、导航、空间推理各环节，SLAM是不可或缺的基础设施，还是正被端到端基础模型、世界模型或隐式空间记忆替代？

paper.title: From Spatial to Actions: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Model in Spatial Foundation Priors

claim: 作者主张：FALCON 用空间基础模型从纯 RGB 输入提供强几何先验（作为 VLA 的空间 grounding 来源），Embodied Spatial Model 在深度或相机位姿可用时可选融合以获得更高保真度，且无需重训或改架构；空间 token 由 Spatial-Enhanced Action Head 消费而非拼进视觉-语言主干，以保留语言推理。

evidence.summary: FALCON 核心主张：空间基础模型从 RGB 提供几何先验，深度/位姿为可选融合条件
evidence.short_quote: FALCON leverages spatial foundation models to deliver strong geometric priors from RGB alone, and includes an Embodied Spatial Model that can optionally fuse depth, or pose for higher fidelity when available, without retraining or architectural changes. To preserve language reasoning, spatial tokens are consumed by a Spatial-Enhanced Action Head rather than being concatenated into the vision-language backbone.

paper.title: From Spatial to Actions: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Model in Spatial Foundation Priors

claim: 作者给出避开显式 3D 输入管线的结构性理由：获取高质量 3D 输入需要昂贵且难以部署的专用传感器，且许多大规模操作数据集（如 Open X-Embodiment）缺乏对齐的 3D 标注、限制可扩展性——因此依赖显式 3D 输入的方法绑定特定模态、在该输入不可用时失效。

evidence.summary: 动机：专用传感器昂贵+OXE 缺 3D 标注，显式 3D 输入路线不可扩展
evidence.short_quote: This stems from two fundamental issues. First, acquiring high-quality 3D inputs requires specialized sensors that are expensive and difficult to deploy in practice. Second, many large-scale manipulation datasets (e.g., Open X-Embodiment dataset [ 29]) lack aligned 3D annotations, limiting scalability.

paper.title: From Spatial to Actions: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Model in Spatial Foundation Priors

claim: 论文相关工作把 DUSt3R 家族定位为传统 SfM 方法的替代：深度学习引入了 SfM 的新替代方案，DUSt3R 不依赖几何约束或归纳偏置、从图像对直接预测点云，代表对'依赖关键点匹配与几何优化的传统 SfM 管线'的重大偏离，在共享坐标系中生成预测从而对初始化敏感性与稀疏对应等经典问题更鲁棒；MASt3R/CUT3R/VGGT 在此范式上继续发展。

evidence.summary: 相关工作：DUSt3R 家族被定位为 traditional SfM 的学习式替代（免关键点匹配/几何优化）
evidence.short_quote: Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced novel alternatives to traditional SfM methods. DUSt3R [ 42] represents a significant deviation from conventional SfM pipelines by predicting point clouds from image pairs without relying on geometric constraints or inductive biases. Unlike traditional SfM, which depends on keypoint matching and geometric optimization, DUSt3R generates predictions in a shared coordinate frame, enabling robust reconstruction across diverse scenes.

evidence.short_quote: Real-world experiments further validate that incorporating depth and camera poses significantly enhances FALCON’s robustness (Fig. 7), increasing task success rates from 60% to 80% in scenarios involving objects of varying heights.

core_citations.role: 弱 3D 线索路线代表（可学习空间嵌入注入 VLM），真机主要对照（Base 44.4% vs FALCON 70.0%）；论文批评其对齐问题

notes: 补充观察：(1) 全文 'SLAM' 一词零出现，也未出现 localization/odometry/loop closure 等词——该论文代表操作/空间推理环节'前馈空间基础模型承担几何职能'的路线，与 UMI/ActiveUMI（采集端 SLAM 位姿）和导航类论文（SLAM 核心领土）构成对照。(2) 与综述问题最相关的三点：空间基础模型谱系被明确表述为 SfM 的替代（C03）；RGB 前馈先验在零样本 CALVIN 上超过真值点云方法（C04）；深度+标定位姿作为可选条件仍有 20pp 增益但非 SLAM 估计产物（C05）。(3) 范围提醒：固定相机桌面操作、无持久地图/状态估计，'替代'结论不能外推到导航环节。(4) extraction.method 按校验器枚举记为 pdf-text（实际提取管道为 alphaxiv full-text API，extraction JSON 的 extraction_method 字段即 pdf-text）。(5) 注意 abstract 称 'three simulation benchmarks'（CALVIN + SimplerEnv 两套设定），正文章节口径一致。

paper_reading.relation: 条件性证据：即便在前馈空间基础模型范式内，传感器供给的几何（深度+已标定相机位姿）在高度敏感任务上仍带来 20 个百分点的成功率增益——说明'几何信息来源'未被完全替代时性能更好；但这些输入是固定相机深度与标定位姿（非 SLAM 估计产物），因此它支持的是'几何价值仍在、但来源可以是传感器+前馈模型而非在线 SLAM'，不构成 SLAM 必要性证据。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 逐字核对 page 11 原文：'incorporating depth and camera poses significantly enhances FALCON’s robustness (Fig. 7), increasing task success rates from 60% to 80% in scenarios involving objects of varying heights'（含 U+2019 撇号）逐字一致；'60% 到 80%' 的数字与对象（高度变化场景）均在所引页面。claim 后半句的 3.91→3.95 出自 page 11 前一段（'RGB-only FALCON benefits from test-time depth input, as Avg. Len. increases from 3.91 to 3.95, matching the performance of model trained with full RGB-D.'）同页，作为上下文并入 claim 并在 task_or_sample 中注明出处。

quantitative.metric: 任务成功率（真机高度变化场景）
quantitative.value_or_direction: 60% → 80%（注入 depth 与 camera poses 后）
quantitative.comparator: with depth and camera poses vs RGB-only（同任务对照，Fig. 7）
quantitative.task_or_sample: 真机高度变化场景（Fig. 7：put white cup on pink cloth–cup height change 等）；另 CALVIN ABC→D 测试时注入深度 3.91→3.95（page 10-11 Table 5）
